subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Soft tissue sarcomas: histological subtypes, staging, multidisciplinary resection, anthracycline chemotherapy and targeted agents

steps.tx: Well-differentiated and dedifferentiated liposarcomas are cytogenetically defined by supernumerary ring and giant marker chromosomes carrying high-level **12q13-15 amplification**. This amplicon contains oncogenes **MDM2** and **CDK4**, which inhibit p53 and phosphorylate RB1, respectively. Detecting nuclear MDM2 overexpression via immunohistochemistry or gene amplification by FISH provides the diagnostic gold standard distinguishing liposarcoma from benign lipomas.

steps.tx: Synovial sarcoma represents a distinctive morphologically biphasic or monophasic soft tissue sarcoma driven by a pathognomonic reciprocal chromosomal translocation **t(X;18)(p11.2;q11.2)**. This structural translocation produces a fusion between the SS18 gene on chromosome 18 and SSX genes on the X chromosome. The chimeric **SS18-SSX** fusion oncoprotein disrupts BAF chromatin remodeling complexes, aberrantly driving oncogenic transcriptional programmes.

right.title: Histopathological Patterns
points: Biphasic: Epithelial glands plus spindle cells
Monophasic: Uniform fascicles of spindle cells
Frequent in young adults around large joints

steps.tx: In advanced metastatic soft tissue sarcomas, first-line systemic chemotherapy relies upon **doxorubicin monotherapy** or combination **doxorubicin plus ifosfamide**. While combining doxorubicin with ifosfamide in the EORTC 62012 trial significantly increased objective response rates from 14% to 26% and prolonged progression-free survival, it did not prolong overall survival, reserving doublet therapy for fit patients needing urgent cytoreduction.

rows: Active in leiomyosarcoma and pleomorphic sarcoma

steps.tx: Marine-derived tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid **Trabectedin** binds the minor groove of DNA, alkylating guanine residues and bending the DNA helix toward the major groove. Trabectedin interferes with transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair and selectively depletes tumour-associated macrophages. Demonstrating substantial antineoplastic efficacy in pretreated advanced **liposarcomas** and **leiomyosarcomas**, trabectedin provides durable disease control with manageable transaminitis.

steps.tx: Novel microtubule inhibitor **Eribulin mesylate** significantly improves overall survival compared to **dacarbazine** in advanced or metastatic pretreated liposarcoma. Demonstrating distinct tubulin-sequestering mechanisms that trigger irreversible mitotic block in G2/M phase, eribulin provides prolonged disease control in patients progressing through prior anthracyclines.

points: Pivotal phase III overall survival trial

right.title: Dacarbazine Control
points: Inferior median overall survival in trial
Limited response rates in pretreated disease
Traditional historical comparator in sarcoma trials

steps.tx: Oral multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor **Pazopanib** inhibits VEGFR1-3, PDGFR-alpha/beta, and KIT receptors to suppress tumour angiogenesis. In the pivotal phase III **PALETTE trial**, pazopanib significantly prolonged progression-free survival compared to placebo in patients with advanced **non-adipocytic soft tissue sarcomas** progressing after prior anthracycline chemotherapy, establishing an effective oral targeted option for leiomyosarcomas, synovial sarcomas, and vascular tumours.

rows: Manageable with dose titrations and antihypertensives

steps.tx: **Desmoid tumours** aggressive fibromatosis represent clonal fibroblastic proliferations characterized by infiltrative local tissue destruction without distant metastatic potential. Molecularly driven by somatic **CTNNB1 beta-catenin** point mutations or germline APC mutations in Gardner syndrome, initial management prioritizes active surveillance. Symptomatic or progressive tumours respond to sorafenib or the novel oral gamma-secretase inhibitor **nirogacestat**.

steps.tx: Cutaneous **angiosarcoma** is an aggressive vascular endothelial malignancy presenting spontaneously on the scalp of elderly patients or secondary to prior radiation or chronic lymphedema in **Stewart-Treves syndrome**. Characterized by malignant endothelial cells forming anastomosing vascular channels, angiosarcomas exhibit exquisite sensitivity to weekly metronomic infusions of **paclitaxel**, achieving rapid objective tumour regression and palliation.
